np-parameter-prose|PCP.InNP|1.annotation: The parameter $P$ is a predicate on Boolean checkers. `InNP` only requires a certificate relative to that predicate, so its meaning as a time class comes from the particular $P$ supplied by the theorem in Section 4.

proof-oracle-prose|PCP.ProofOracle|1.annotation: The soundness quantifier ranges over all such sequences, including ones without a computable description. An address bound is why one can nevertheless replace a complete sequence by a finite witness in the converse in Section 5.

algorithm-time-prose|PCP.Machine.PolyTim.annotation: The runtime bound concerns one step on the encoded input, seed and history. In the main theorem in Section 4 the seed length is logarithmic and the history has bounded length, so this yields polynomial time for the full capped run.

pcp-summary|PCP.np_subset_pcp|1.annotation: `np_subset_pcp` proves the forward inclusion. Its `ReadsBelow` and implementation clauses make the asymptotic resource statement usable in the concrete machine model. Equality of the classes uses the separate converse in Section 5.
